chunks: So fear Allah, O servants of Allah,

directing your fear towards the purpose for which He created you, and be afraid of Him to the utmost extent He has warned you to fear Him from Himself. And make yourselves deserving of what He has prepared for you by fulfilling [His promise] with the truth of His pledge and fearing the terror of His return.

key_terms.هَوْلِ مَعَادِهِ: terror of His return/Day of Reckoning

ai.seo_question: How should one fear Allah according to the purpose of creation?
ai.summary: In this opening of the famous Al-Gharra sermon, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the foundation of piety by linking the purpose of creation (3:30, 51:56) to the urgency of the Hereafter. He emphasizes that true fear of Allah involves not only recognizing His authority but also actively securing divine reward through sincere adherence to His covenant and awareness of the terrifying reality of the Day of Return.
